parameters.name: Cores
parameters.description: The number of vCPUs of the instance type. For more information, see [Instance family](~~25378~~).

parameters.name: GpuAmount
parameters.description: The number of GPUs of the GPU-accelerated instance. For more information, see [Overview of GPU-accelerated instances](~~108496~~).

parameters.name: GpuSpec
parameters.description:
The GPU type. Valid values:

- NVIDIA P4
- NVIDIA T4
- NVIDIA P100 
- NVIDIA V100

Default value: null, which indicates that all types are queried. For more information, see [Overview of GPU-accelerated instances](~~108496~~).

parameters.name: InstanceFamilyLevel
parameters.description:
The level of the instance family. Valid values:

- EntryLevel: entry level.
- EnterpriseLevel: enterprise level.
- CreditEntryLevel: credit-based entry level. For more information, see [Burstable instances](~~59977~~).

Default value: null, which indicates that all levels are queried.

parameters.name: InstanceTypeFamily
parameters.description: The instance family. For more information, see [Instance family](~~25378~~).

parameters.name: InstanceTypes
parameters.description: The list of instance types. You can specify up to 10 instance types.

parameters.name: Memory
parameters.description: The memory size of the instance type. Unit: GiB. For more information, see [Instance family](~~25378~~).

parameters.name: MinCores
parameters.description: The minimum number of vCPUs of the instance type. For more information, see [Instance family](~~25378~~).

parameters.name: MinMemory
parameters.description: The minimum memory size of the instance type. For more information, see [Instance family](~~25378~~).

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: ZoneId
parameters.description:
The zone ID.

Default value: null, which indicates that all zones in the specified region are queried.
